hcontainer.p: (40) The Accountability for Onward Transfer Principle should also be read in conjunction with the Notice Principle and, in the case of an onward transfer to a third party controller (58), with the Choice Principle, according to which data subjects must be informed (among others) about the type/identity of any third party recipient, the purpose of the onward transfer and the choice offered, and can object (opt out) or, in the case of sensitive data, have to give “affirmative express consent” (opt in) for the onward transfer.
